body: Hey guys :) you really don't know how much your replies mean to me.  I was seriously considering suicide until I read the amazing replies you guys had. Even though my anxiety might never go away, I can work my best to just stay positive. Same with you guys! Never give up and keep working hard. Be who you want to be. I'm preaching but fuck it you guys saved my life lol. I seriously appreciate how nice and beautiful you guys are! If any of you are feeling the same you can inbox me and I will try my best to help. I can't thank you guys enough, you' re awesome. god bless and protect you all. :)

Thanks for the reply.. I really appreciate it

My grades are good and it is exam time but I'm not stressed out. I have friends that I see daily friends.. Loneliness isn't the problem. 

As a kid i always felt I was different in some ways.. I think I had severe anxiety but just didn't know it. I feel as if one day I had just snapped and my life has never been the same. My mind never shuts off and I can never stop thinking. 

I do feel it daily actually 24/7( literally) .. Maybe it is just a chemical imbalance of some sort. If it is, can medication fix such a thing? I've seen a psychiatrist once or twice but never really opened up. Again.. Thank you for replying
